gist: An easy opening to be seen appears; it only works if you walk through before overthinking it.

en.body: A door is open a few inches, and it's about you being visible. Walk through it before you decide you need a better outfit.
en.notification: Be the first to speak in the room.

tr.body: Bir kapı aralık ve mesele görünür olmak. Daha iyi bir kıyafete ihtiyacın olduğuna karar vermeden içeri gir.

gist: Comfort is offered in the right shape; the task is receiving it without turning it into debt.

en.body: Someone is offering the exact kind of comfort you like. Let it in without translating it into a favor you owe.

tr.body: Biri tam sevdiğin türden bir teselli sunuyor. Borçlanacağın bir iyiliğe çevirmeden içeri al.

gist: The avoided message has an easy route today, but only if perfectionism doesn't intervene.

en.body: The sentence you've been avoiding has a soft landing today. Send it before the perfect wording shows up; it won't.

tr.body: Kaçındığın cümlenin bugün yumuşak bir inişi var. Mükemmel ifade gelmeden gönder; zaten gelmeyecek.

gist: Attraction is uncomplicated today, and a small invitation expresses more than a speech would.

en.body: Liking someone is allowed to be simple today. Suggest the coffee, the walk, the shared playlist; small invitations carry more than speeches.
en.notification: Make the small invitation. Skip the speech.

tr.body: Birinden hoşlanmak bugün basit olabilir. Kahveyi, yürüyüşü, ortak çalma listesini öner; küçük davetler konuşmalardan çok taşır.

gist: Drive cooperates with mood, and a task with a visible finish line benefits most.

en.body: Your get-up-and-go is cooperative today. Pick the task with a visible finish line and let momentum do the rest.

tr.body: İçindeki kıpırtı bugün işbirlikçi. Bitiş çizgisi görünen işi seç, gerisini ivmeye bırak.

gist: Generosity flows easily; small acts of sharing return in ways nobody tracks.

en.body: Generosity comes naturally today. Share the tip, the contact, the half of the sandwich; it comes back in ways you didn't invoice.
en.notification: Give freely. Don't keep a ledger.

tr.body: Cömertlik bugün kendiliğinden geliyor. İpucunu, tanıdığını, sandviçin yarısını paylaş; faturasını kesmediğin yollardan geri döner.

gist: Boundaries come easily, and an early, plain no prevents a string of resentful yeses.

en.body: You're oddly good at boundaries today. A polite no, said early and plainly, will save you three resentful yeses.
en.notification: A clean no is a kindness.

tr.body: Bugün sınır koymakta tuhaf biçimde iyisin. Erken ve açık söylenen kibar bir hayır, kırgın üç evetten seni kurtarır.

gist: Curiosity gives a gentle push toward something unusual; a small detour is enough to satisfy it.

en.body: Curiosity is pulling at your sleeve. Follow one odd link, ask one off-topic question; a small detour is all it needs.

tr.body: Merak, yenine asılıyor. Tuhaf bir bağlantıyı izle, konu dışı bir soru sor; küçük bir sapma yetiyor.

gist: Empathy is easy and the room's mood seeps in; it helps to aim it at one person rather than absorb everything.

en.body: Empathy comes easily, and you're picking up the room's mood. Use it to be kind to one person; don't absorb all of it.
en.notification: Feel it, then set it down.

tr.body: Empati kolay geliyor, odanın havasını üstüne çekiyorsun. Bunu tek bir kişiye iyi davranmak için kullan; hepsini emme.

gist: A truth usually circled is within reach and is easiest to approach privately.

en.body: A truth you usually circle is within reach, and it doesn't need an audience. Write it down privately and see what it asks of you.
en.notification: Honest and alone counts as a start.

tr.body: Genelde etrafında dönüp durduğun bir doğru elinin altında ve seyirci istemiyor. Kendi başına yaz, senden ne istediğine bak.
